import os,json,gzip,hashlib,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,urllib.request,time
root=pathlib.Path('/home/scales/.local/share/one-wave-circuit-builder');root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
raw=gzip.decompress(urllib.request.urlopen('__ARTIFACT_URL__',timeout=30).read())
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='d4de988873bdda6566b83e2e912e64fccef58f3ae8b77895b9d405f56baff288','Artifact checksum mismatch'
app=root/'Circuit_Builder_Run.cjs'
if app.exists(): assert app.read_bytes()==raw,'Existing app differs; preserve it'
else: app.write_bytes(raw)
runtime=root/'ngspice'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=subprocess.run(['apt-get','download','ngspice','libxaw7','libxft2'],cwd=td,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
 assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 for f in pathlib.Path(td).glob('*.deb'): subprocess.run(['dpkg-deb','-x',str(f),str(runtime)],check=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['NGSPICE_BIN']=str(runtime/'usr/bin/ngspice');env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=str(runtime/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')
p=subprocess.run([env['NGSPICE_BIN'],'--version'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
unit=pathlib.Path('/home/scales/.config/systemd/user/one-wave-circuit-builder.service');unit.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
text='[Unit]\nDescription=One-Wave Circuit Builder\n[Service]\nExecStart=/usr/bin/node '+str(app)+'\nEnvironment=NGSPICE_BIN='+env['NGSPICE_BIN']+'\nEnvironment=LD_LIBRARY_PATH='+env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']+'\nRestart=on-failure\n[Install]\nWantedBy=default.target\n'
if unit.exists(): assert unit.read_text()==text,'Existing unit differs; preserve it'
else: unit.write_text(text)
env['XDG_RUNTIME_DIR']='/run/user/1000';env['DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus'
for args in [['daemon-reload'],['enable','--now',unit.name]]: subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user']+args,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True)
for i in range(20):
 try:
  page=urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8787',timeout=2).read();break
 except Exception:time.sleep(.2)
assert b'Circuit Builder' in page
spec={'program':'Virtual_3D_Electronics','parts':[{'id':x,'type':'pad'} for x in ['G','I','O']]+[{'id':'V','type':'dcsource','volts':1,'rInternal':0,'plus':'I','minus':'G'},{'id':'R1','type':'resistor','ohms':1000,'a':'I','b':'O'},{'id':'R2','type':'resistor','ohms':1000,'a':'O','b':'G'}],'analysis':{'type':'dc'}}
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/ngspice',data=json.dumps(spec).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
r=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20));v=next(t for t in r['traces'] if t['name']=='V(O)')['values'][-1];assert abs(v-.5)<1e-8
env['DISPLAY']=':0';subprocess.Popen(['xdg-open','http://127.0.0.1:8787'],env=env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
print(json.dumps({'host':os.uname().nodename,'app':str(app),'service':'active','engine':r['engine'],'divider_V':v,'browser_open_requested':True}))
